purpose: Allocate each governance power to the measurement it actually needs. Exists because a single composite scalar was asked to answer three different questions — who deserves authority, how much infrastructure to buy, how long an actor has been present — and answered none of them while favouring incumbents.

measure_classes.sensor: Physical, observed by a probe. Not declared, and not consensus-observed.
measure_classes.revealed: Inferred from third-party behaviour. Cannot be manufactured without producing something other actors actually need.
measure_classes.capped: An envelope with a hard limit. Scores are inadmissible.
measure_classes.stated: Self-reported or purchased. Inadmissible for every power. Listed to make the prohibition total rather than partial.

allocation.subject: infrastructure budget
allocation.falsifier: A declared or self-reported resource figure that a sensor contradicts, at a rate that makes sensors no better.
allocation.note: Physical and therefore consensus-free. This is the one power that needs no governance at all, only accounting.

allocation.subject: what to build next
allocation.falsifier: A corpus where stated demand predicts build success better than observed attention flow.
allocation.note: Demand rather than intention. The decaying window is what keeps a burst from outranking a sustained audience.

allocation.subject: legitimacy and continuity
allocation.falsifier: A system where cumulative retention predicts survival better than current attention.
allocation.note: Durability rather than novelty. Paired with P-next under INV-10: the same quantity, two variants, two powers, never one.

allocation.subject: admission and contribution
allocation.falsifier: A self-reported contribution signal that resists capture at community scale.
allocation.note: Whether THIS actor is consumed. Not a popularity proxy, not a purchaseable metric. See INV-09.

allocation.subject: treasury allocation
allocation.falsifier: A weighted-scored treasury that survives a legal action better than a capped one.
allocation.note: Where confiscation risk lives. A score in this decision converts a budget into a claim.

invariants.statement: A measurement may govern at most one power.
No power may be governed by a measurement its beneficiary can influence directly.
For any quantity q, q_flow and q_stock must govern different powers.
P-treasury is allocated by envelope and cap, never by a score.
Retention is a share of consumers over a window divided by consumers over lifetime. An absolute count is inadmissible.
Work with no observable third-party consumption has weight zero. Activity is not value.
Attention is generated by being spent and destroyed by neglect. No rule may derive from an assumed conservation of attention.
A weight function with no loss term is inadmissible.
A measurement parameter is null until calibrated against a measured corpus. An aesthetic constant is inadmissible, including by physical analogy.
Whoever arbitrates between measures is bound by the published constraint set and may be removed without damage to the system's existence.
invariants.coverage_note: INV-17 constrains a person, not a structure. No check can verify it, and the contract says so rather than implying otherwise.

loss_terms.name: context_rivalry
loss_terms.mechanism: N parallel agents destroy each other's context
loss_terms.note: Invisible in any agent's self-report. This is the price a swarm pays for parallelism.

loss_terms.name: verification
loss_terms.mechanism: attention spent coordinating instead of producing

loss_terms.name: attribution
loss_terms.mechanism: attention flows to the agent rather than the work

loss_terms.name: homogenisation
loss_terms.note: Retention is necessarily below one. A service used by everyone is used by nobody attentively, which is why INV-12 mandates a share rather than a count.

rejected_models.model: attention as energy, V x I = power
reasons: attention is not conserved: it is generated by being spent and destroyed by neglect, so no conservation law can be derived
V x I computes energy, not power: intensity is a flow while accumulated volume is a stock, and their product is not a rate
the admissible model is contagion — propagation by contact, saturation, decay
rejected_models.discipline: The analogy generates hypotheses. It never justifies a constant.

rejected_models.model: single composite scalar over capital, contribution and tenure
rejected_models.note: The anti-whale modifier multiplied the stake ratio from 100 to 1 000 000. The refutation of a wrong composite is not evidence for a good one.

rejected_models.model: seven-dimension E-Score as a merit score
rejected_models.note: Ploutocracy dressed as meritocracy; constants refuted as aesthetic; and the abstractions do not travel — GitHub Stars are a quantity anyone can purchase, so 'verified contribution to shared digital goods' does not survive contact with the thing it names.

rejected_models.model: majority of contributors as the alignment mechanism
rejected_models.note: Every agent wants more compute and none wants to cap it. The majority preference is inflationary while survival requires deflation. Aggregation is not alignment.

calibration.reason_null: No measured corpus exists. An uncalibrated constant is a belief, and this contract does not ship beliefs as numbers.
calibration.admissibility: A non-null value requires a named corpus, a stated tolerance, and a falsifier. See INV-16.

arbiter.problem: Arbitration costs something, and with a single operator the arbiter is the operator. This reintroduces the centralisation the design exists to prevent, and no mechanism removes it.
arbiter.resolution: Not a solution. A constraint on a person: the arbiter is published, measured, contestable, and removable without destroying the system.
arbiter.honesty: Recorded because the alternative is claiming the problem is solved.

violations.statement: One measurement is allocated to two or more powers.
violations.remediation: Split the measurement. Two powers with different failure modes need different instruments.

violations.statement: A power is governed by a stated or self-reported measure.
violations.remediation: Replace with third-party consumption, or accept the decision cannot be made from evidence.

violations.statement: A quantity's flow and stock govern the same power.
violations.remediation: Assign one of them to a different power.

violations.statement: A score contributes to a treasury decision.
violations.remediation: Replace the score with an envelope and a cap.

violations.statement: A calibration constant is non-null without a measured corpus.

enforcement.coverage_note: Six properties are executable. INV-17 is not, and is declared unbacked rather than counted as covered.

known_exclusions: P-next and P-admit cannot be exercised: ChatTrace token counts are Option<u64> = None with no production TraceSink attached, so no retention signal exists to arbitrate on.
No runtime code consumes this allocation yet. It is a declared decision surface, and the six checks verify the declaration rather than a computation.

promotion_requires: Power and MeasureClass exist as distinct Rust types so that INV-08 is unrepresentable rather than checked
a retention signal exists, so that P-next and P-admit derive to a value rather than unknown
lambda and saturation remain null, or gain a named corpus and a stated tolerance
